title: When the Echo Wakes Again
author: Ivo Reyes
blurb: Hazel Galloway, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
